description: Melissa's Story Melissa Butcher’s roots in Wyoming run deep. Born in Sheridan, she grew up traveling the state with her dad during road construction seasons, gaining an early appreciation for Wyoming’s landscapes, industries, and the people who do the work that keeps communities going.
